description: Screen companies by price range, volume, cash runway, float, shares outstanding, market cap, industry, listing exchange (NASDAQ/NYSE/AMEX), listing market (market="otc" / "exchange"; the reliable OTC test, as the exchange label is inconsistent on OTC rows), float data source, TTM dividend yield and snapshot cash (minCash / maxCash). Sort by any sortable column. Returns matching companies with key metrics and pagination. FLOAT: "float" is the measured POINT float (null on a withheld dilution-snapshot row, which then carries "floatEstimate" + "floatEstimateBound" ("point" / "ceiling" / "floor") + "floatEstimateBasis"). Print a point as the plain number with its basis as the caveat; a ceiling / floor is a BOUND, not a figure: write "float not stated (at most / at least N)", never the bare number or a "~" / "<=" / ">=" glyph. minFloat / maxFloat and the computed_float sort use the figure's VALUE, so a bounded row is kept; a row with neither is NOT MEASURED, never 0. Never feed floatEstimate into a market cap, percent-of-float or short-interest ratio. `shares_outstanding` is DATED by `sharesOutstandingAsOf` + `sharesOutstandingAsOfKind` (stated / checked / none = date not recorded) and `sharesOutstandingSource`; never present the count without its date. CASH RUNWAY: a null cash_runway_months carries cashRunwayReason. "estimate_would_be_negative" = the last cash figure (dated cashRunwayAsOf) rolled forward by burn is below zero: ESTIMATED exhausted, not a reported zero balance; maxCashRunway drops such rows unless includeRunwayExhausted=true. Any other or null reason is NOT a runway claim. estimatedCurrentCash (estimatedCashAsOf) is the snapshot's USD cash PROJECTION, only for snapshot-covered companies: null = NOT MEASURED, never "no cash"; a non-USD filer has it null and is never matched by minCash / maxCash. dividendYield (TTM cash dividends with an ex-date in the last 365 days / current price, %), nextExDate, lastExDate: null = NOT MEASURED or not a payer, never 0%. listingMarket: "exchange" / "otc", null = unknown. Each row carries live trading-halt status (halted/haltCode/haltedAt; false/null when trading normally); pass excludeHalted=true to drop currently-halted tickers.

country.description: Company universe by issuer domicile: "US" (default), "CA" (Canadian companies via their US-OTC/US cross-listings), or "all"

exchange.description: Filter by listing exchange: NASDAQ (every tier), NYSE (includes NYSE Arca), or AMEX (NYSE American). Each matches every spelling of that exchange; names that moved to OTC never match. For OTC use market="otc" instead

excludeHalted.description: When true, exclude tickers with a currently-active trading halt (regulatory or volatility) from the results. Default false — halted rows are included and carry halted/haltCode/haltedAt fields.

includeRunwayExhausted.description: When true, maxCashRunway also returns companies whose estimated cash is already exhausted (cash_runway_months null, cashRunwayReason "estimate_would_be_negative"); they sort first on an ascending runway sort. Default false

industry.description: Filter by company industry (exact match, e.g. "Biotechnology", "Software")

market.description: Listing market: "otc" (OTC Markets) or "exchange" (NASDAQ / NYSE / NYSE American / Arca / Cboe). Companies with no listing record match neither

maxCash.description: Maximum dilution-snapshot cash projection in USD (estimatedCurrentCash). Snapshot-covered companies only — an uncovered company is not measured, not excluded for having cash

maxCashRunway.description: Maximum estimated months of cash remaining

maxDividendYield.description: Maximum TTM dividend yield in percent. Rows with no measured yield never match.

maxMarketCapComputed.description: Maximum market cap in USD (price * shares outstanding)

maxSharesOutstanding.description: Maximum shares outstanding from SEC EDGAR

minCash.description: Minimum dilution-snapshot cash projection in USD (estimatedCurrentCash). Snapshot-covered companies reporting in USD only

minCashRunway.description: Minimum estimated months of cash remaining

minDividendYield.description: Minimum TTM dividend yield in percent (e.g. 3 for 3%). Rows with no measured yield never match.

minMarketCapComputed.description: Minimum market cap in USD (price * shares outstanding)

minSharesOutstanding.description: Minimum shares outstanding from SEC EDGAR

sortBy.description: Column to sort results by (default: volume)
